تحتازي (form VIII)
# تَحْتَازِي (taḥtāzī) /taħ.taː.ziː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
# تُحْتَازِي (tuḥtāzī) /tuħ.taː.ziː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَازَ (iḥtāza)
